### Data and Purpose

This project uses NPS-reported annual recreation visits to compare visitation across units and years. The 2000–2025 dataset contains 9,612 park-year records from 400 units. Counts represent reported visits, not unique people; reporting units and counting methods can vary. Data: [NPS IRMA Stats Portal](https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/) and [NPS Visitor Use Statistics Dashboard](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/socialscience/visitor-use-statistics-dashboard.htm).
:::
